name: Japanese Numerals, Digits and Dashes
description: How the numbers of a Japanese block are written: kanji numerals, full-width and half-width digits, the markers 丁目, 番, 番地 and 号, and every dash that stands between the numbers. Original case written for this corpuss; shapes follow Japan Post's guidance on writing an address (郵便番号・住所の書き方), described in our own words; nothing copied, and the residence indication system (住居表示, Act on Residence Indication, 1962): chome, ban and go.

kanjiNumerals.source: Original case written for this corpus; Japan Post's guidance on writing an address (郵便番号・住所の書き方), described in our own words; nothing copied
